name: Grain
description: Grain captures and transcribes your meetings where you have them: Meet, Zoom, Teams, Slack, and more. Grain builds an AI Meeting Data Layer of transcripts, notes, and enriched context that Claude uses to power your work. Example prompts: "Draft a proposal for AcmeCo using context from every call we've had with them." "What pain points came up most across our user interviews this month?" "Summarize the team meetings I missed this week and flag anything I should weigh in on." "Find and clip recent moments where customers pushed back on pricing to share with sales." "Create a project for AcmeCo with every meeting we've had with them so I can prep for our QBR."

_published_faq.name: How do I add Grain to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Grain to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://api.grain.com/_/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Grain MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Grain lists 21 MCP tools, including myself, list_meetings, list_attended_meetings, fetch_meeting, fetch_meeting_notes, fetch_meeting_transcript, search_persons, search_companies, search_meetings, list_workspace_users, list_coaching_feedback, and fetch_meeting_coaching_feedback.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Grain?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Grain in communication on the Manufact MCP catalog include AgentLine: Phone Numbers for AI Agents, JooVoice, OpenMail, Granola, and Fleet Connected Apps.
Grain requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Grain is developed by Grain. It is listed as partner on the Claude connector directory.
